verdict.line: You lose if Renekton stacks 50+ Fury and chains W into Q before level 6; you win if you reach mid-game intact, where Ornn's 56.4% head-to-head win rate over 1561 games takes over.

brief.thesis: Renekton has lane and solo-kill advantage because his kit front-loads burst: a 0.75-1.5s stun from W (Ruthless Predator), a gap-closing E (Slice and Dice), and a Fury bar that empowers both. Ornn has no stun and no reliable gap-closer in lane since E (Searing Charge) only knocks up off terrain collision, so he cannot win a straight all-in before items. The matchup flips once Ornn hits his defensive power spikes and Renekton's early edge stops mattering.

theirWindow.when: Fury above 50 and E off cooldown
theirWindow.what: His Q (Cull the Meek) and W (Ruthless Predator) both upgrade past 50 Fury — W adds a third slash, destroys your shields, and extends the stun to 1.5s. Do not stand still near minions and let him farm Fury into you; disengage from the wave instead of trading.

yourWindow.when: his E (Slice and Dice) is on cooldown
yourWindow.what: E is his only dash and it's down for 16/14.5/13/11.5/10s per rank. When it's spent, he can't close distance fast — step up and land Q (Volcanic Rupture, 9-7s cooldown) for the slow and free poke without exposing yourself to a stun combo.

powerCurve.note: W online at 2 with no answer from you
full combo all-in, solo-kill risk peaks
Dominus adds sustain to his all-in
Brittle and first items close the gap
resistance stacking and R zoning take over

start.why: The regen and physical damage reduction directly offset Renekton's auto-reliant Fury generation and early poke, keeping you above the threshold where his all-in becomes lethal.

boots.why: Renekton's entire kit is physical damage delivered through autos and stun-combo follow-ups; flat physical reduction blunts both his poke and his all-in burst.

core.why: Health and dual resistances let you survive the level 3-6 all-in window while the immolate aura adds free damage in extended trades.
Renekton's R (Dominus) and Q (Cull the Meek) both heal him; Grievous Wounds from Thornmail cuts that sustain directly, turning his all-in into a losing trade for him.
By level 12+ this is where the matchup flips — stacking resistances makes you nearly unkillable in skirmishes, matching the late-game edge.

situational.when: he rushes lifesteal or snowballs kills early and his sustain needs cutting immediately
you need the shield proc to survive his W-into-E all-in before Thornmail is online
the enemy team shifts toward magic damage later and Renekton alone isn't the threat anymore

runes.keystoneWhy: Grasp heals and grows your max health off a single auto per trade, which directly answers a lane where you're forced to play reactive short trades instead of all-ins.

summoners.why: Flash is your only tool to dodge his W stun into E all-in before level 6; Teleport lets you play passive and give up some CS or tempo without losing map presence, which matters since you're not winning the lane outright.

playing.title: Track the Fury bar, not just HP
playing.detail: Renekton's trade power doubles past 50 Fury on both Q and W. If his Fury is low, a trade is far safer than the HP bars alone suggest.

playing.title: Don't contest pre-6 all-ins solo
playing.detail: Solo-kill advantage is his in this matchup. Play for CS with Q poke from range and ask for jungle pressure instead of standing in melee range of his full combo.

playing.title: Punish his E cooldown
playing.detail: Slice and Dice is 16-10s depending on rank. The moment he dashes in and it's down, that's your window to step up and land Q without fear of a follow-up stun.

playing.title: Apply Brittle before you commit
playing.detail: The final gout of W (Bellows Breath) or a landed Q pillar both apply Brittle, which increases damage taken — land that before trading, not after.

playing.title: Respect W off cooldown post-6
playing.detail: Once he has Dominus up, a landed W can turn into a full kill attempt with sustain. If his W is up and yours (Fury) reads high, back off the wave.

playing.title: Take over with R in skirmishes
playing.detail: Once Sunfire and Thornmail are online, Call of the Forge God's knock-up and Brittle application in a group fight is where Ornn's scaling actually wins the game.

brief.patchCaveat: The build, runes, and summoner spells here are pulled directly from measured OP.GG games on the current patch; the trade-pattern and cooldown-window reasoning is my own read of the ability kits, not aggregate data.

stats.opponentTip: Be careful of prolonging early game combat. Be careful of Renekton dealing damage one-sidedly. Keep in mind that Renekton can recover health with (R) when going in to kill him.
